commands: git status --porcelain; echo "---RUNENV---"; echo "run_id=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-none} attempt=${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-none}"; echo "---PRVIEW---"; gh pr view 1685 --json headRefName,baseRefName,baseRefOid,headRefOid,body,closingIssuesReferences --jq '{head:.headRefName,base:.baseRefName,baseOid:.baseRefOid,headOid:.headRefOid,closes:.closingIssuesReferences}'

for f in phase-1-setup phase-2-implement phase-3-ac-gate phase-4-documentation phase-2-sweeps-contract; do echo "=== $f ==="; git show f36215ad:skills/implement/phases/$f.md 2>&1 | grep -nE '^#|§|Documentation-AC|post-merge|Test-first gate' | head -40; done

for f in issue-template step-3-5-steelman; do echo "=== $f ==="; git show f36215ad:skills/create-issue/references/$f.md 2>&1 | grep -niE 'every ac|maps to|orphan|named assertion|mirror' | head -20; done

for f in step-3-6-audit audit-prompt-template; do echo "=== $f ==="; git show f36215ad:skills/create-issue/references/$f.md 2>&1 | grep -niE 'every ac|maps to|named assertion|testing strategy.*assert|orphan' | head; done
for f in skills/create-issue/references/issue-template.md skills/implement/phases/phase-2-sweeps-contract.md; do echo -n "$f: "; git show f36215ad:$f 2>/dev/null | wc -c; done
